# ChromaDie

ChromaDie is a daily color-rolling game. Players roll a new color, discover its rarity and traits, earn EP, unlock cosmetics, and compare results on public leaderboards.

## Public pages

- [Play ChromaDie](https://chm.lol/)
- [How to Play](https://chm.lol/how-to-play)
- [Leaderboard](https://chm.lol/leaderboard)
- [Privacy Policy](https://chm.lol/privacy)

## Public profile pages

Public player profiles are available at `https://chm.lol/{username}` when a player has a public profile and meaningful activity. Existing `/u/{username}` links remain compatibility routes during the staged cutover.

## Sharing

Challenge links are available at `https://chm.lol/c/{challenge-id}` and may expire.
